create_stable_cascade_decoder_pipeline: create a StableCascadeDecoderPipeline instance from pretrained stabilityai/stable-cascade model with bfloat16 dtype
run_stable_cascade_image_generation: run the StableCascadeDecoderPipeline to generate images from image embeddings and a text prompt with 10 inference steps
encode_stable_cascade_prompt: encode text prompts into CLIP text embeddings with pooled embeddings for StableCascadeDecoderPipeline inference
prepare_stable_cascade_latents: prepare initial noisy latents scaled by scheduler init_noise_sigma matching VQ latent space dimensions from image embeddings
decode_stable_cascade_latents: decode denoised latents through PaellaVQModel VQGAN to produce final output images in pil, np, or pt format
